QuestInfo.name: [Identisk] Fake Statue
QuestInfo.0: Baz suspects that the ancient god statues on Iden Island and Tisk Island could be fake. Could this be true? Go and consult Iden Island's scholar, #bObin#k.
QuestInfo.1: Obin was in a fix when you asked about the statue, and he wanted you to go with him to Mural Cave. Go to the cave on Identisk Island.
QuestInfo.2: Obin confirmed that the ancient god statue was not modeled after the real ancient god. Because the mural of the ancient god had faded so badly, the sculptor had no reference for the statue...

default.0: Let's go to the #bMural Cave#k. You will understand when you see the mural on the wall.
